title: Reconsidering Positional Supervision in Masked Diffusion Language Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2601.22947v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by unmasking tokens in parallel and have recently emerged as alternatives to autoregressive language models. They can be viewed as parallel decoders trained with a position-wise cross-entropy (CE) loss, the same setup as non-autoregressive translation (NAT). In NAT, CE-trained parallel decoders have been argued to be sensitive to small positional shifts, since CE penalizes them harshly. We ask whether CE-trained MDLMs are similarly sensitive to such shifts under iterative decoding. To probe this, we apply a controlled intervention that introduces them during decoding. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct with Arena-Hard, displacing as little as 1% of generated tokens by one position substantially reduces win rates against the unintervened model, showing that MDLMs are sensitive to such small shifts under iterative parallel decoding. translated_title: 重新思考掩码扩散语言模型训练中的位置监督
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）通过并行解除掩码的方式生成文本，近来已成为自回归语言模型的替代方案。它们可以被视为采用逐位置交叉熵（CE）损失训练的并行解码器，这一设置与非自回归翻译（NAT）相同。在NAT领域，已有观点认为采用CE训练的并行解码器对微小的位置偏移十分敏感，因为CE会对这类偏移施加严厉惩罚。我们探究了采用CE训练的MDLMs在迭代解码下是否对这类偏移同样敏感。为验证这一点，我们施加了一种受控干预，在解码过程中引入位置偏移。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct模型与Arena-Hard基准上，仅将1%的生成token移动一个位置，就会显著降低相对于未干预模型的胜率，这表明MDLMs在迭代并行解码下对如此微小的偏移非常敏感。受此启发，我们改造了连接主义时间分类（CTC）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过受控干预实验发现掩码扩散语言模型在迭代并行解码下对微小的位置偏移极为敏感（仅偏移1%的token即显著降低胜率），并据此提出改造连接主义时间分类（CTC）以改进位置监督。
en_tdlr: This paper shows via controlled interventions that masked diffusion language models are highly sensitive to tiny positional shifts during iterative parallel decoding (displacing just 1% of tokens substantially reduces win rates), and accordingly adapts connectionist temporal classification (CTC) to improve positional supervision.
